_generated.do_not_edit: Generated file. Change the inputs and re-run the script.

how_status_is_derived.compacted-commit: done: a fix/feat commit on main with subject "... pkt/V1-<ID> (compacted)". Certain.
how_status_is_derived.prior-status-file: done or todo as V1-STATUS-2026-11-20.json recorded it ("merged-main" or "todo"). Certain for done; todo means no later evidence was found.
how_status_is_derived.prior-status-file+wave-2b-commit: done: the prior file said "wave-2b" and the wave 2b commit is on main. Certain.
how_status_is_derived.code-commit-subject: done: a fix/feat commit on main names the packet id, but not in the compacted form. UNCERTAIN: the commit may be a partial or a repair.
how_status_is_derived.unmerged-branch: in-progress: only with --with-branches (never in the committed file). origin/pkt/V1-<ID> exists in this clone and no done evidence is on main. UNCERTAIN: depends on which branches this clone has fetched; a stale branch also counts.
how_status_is_derived.prior-status-file(in-progress): in-progress: the prior file said so and nothing newer is on main. UNCERTAIN.
how_status_is_derived.prior-status-file(wave-2b): in-progress: the prior file said "wave-2b" and no wave 2b commit is on main. UNCERTAIN. Cannot occur on main today.
how_status_is_derived.no-evidence: todo: the packet was added to the plan after the prior status file and no fix or feat commit on main names it (docs and test commits may).

limits: Work on wave PRs, unpushed worktrees and child sessions is invisible here: see ORCHESTRATOR-STATE.md section 3.

The committed file is a function of main alone, so it shows no in-progress work that is only on a branch. For a branch view run: git fetch origin "+refs/heads/pkt/*:refs/remotes/origin/pkt/*" && node scripts/agent-memory/status.mjs --with-branches --stdout
A compacted commit that was later reverted still counts as done: the script reads subjects, not trees.
The plan critical path was computed at the re-cut (validation.critical_path) and does not include packets added later.
